timestampRules: MissingOrWrongKind: timestamp missing, non-string, or blank. This matches the existing missing-timestamp branch; actual field description remains its exact source diagnostic.
ParseRejected: nonblank string fails the existing ambient DateTimeOffset.TryParse(string,out _) predicate.
ParseAccepted: that exact existing ambient predicate succeeds; the discarded parsed value is not retained or invented.
NotReached iff document is not Object. Do not re-evaluate ambient timestamp policy during decoding, resume or cold consumption.

A useful dialogueOptions/image_prompt property with absent/null/blank timestamp receives the one ordinary fallback before these tail checks. Wrong-kind or nonblank invalid timestamps do not acquire a new fallback.

rules: Preserve exact per-row scalar values, order, duplicates and nulls from the actual computation. Do not sort/deduplicate the issue vector.
Freshness warning is first when produced by actual validated-original comparison. Do not strengthen warning to Error or synthesize it when original policy returns no baseline.
Within the object prefix: dialogueOptions array order and text/inputValue/category checks; then image_prompt; then missing-payload. Timestamp follows, then unknown fields in source enumeration order.

All schema objects reject duplicate, unknown or missing required fields and unknown enum values; issue text is retained data, not authority.
Read/IO/projector/owning-release faults are not an invented completed parse disposition. Apply typed held/uncertain control separately; absence of a complete record never proves I was unrun.

Error-bearing computed result is retained and excluded from no-Error common admission. Exact candidate must choose its held publication disposition explicitly; no generic repair replacement or recomputation.

If any required current admission cannot be obtained, retain and hold. A finite source/fixture map of these exact callees is a remaining whole-vertical acceptance obligation, not an existing proof of implemented resume.

Those clocks and first-versus-committed-effect distinctions must be separately counted/qualified; committed ticks/costs/actions never repeat.
